blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Real-time magnetic resonance imaging of the vocal tract makes speech articulation directly observable, but the trade-off between temporal resolution and signal quality introduces substantial noise and obscures fine articulatory detail. Since clean references cannot be acquired for a moving vocal tract, supervised denoising approaches are not applicable in this setting. We propose a self-supervised denoising framework that combines spatiotemporal super-resolution learning with pseudo-supervision derived from a variance-stabilized non-local means filter. A dual-model fusion strategy balances noise suppression and preservation of high-frequency articulatory structure. Experiments on the USC-75 multi-speaker dataset under natural noise conditions show that the ensemble raises the signal-to-noise ratio by 11.9 dB on unseen subjects while attaining more high-frequency articulatory content in the frames. Among tuned implementations of anisotropic diffusion, block-matching filtering, non-local means and pre-smoothed non-local means, every configuration that achieves comparable noise suppression does so at the cost of high-frequency content or of structural fidelity. Under severe added Gaussian, Rayleigh and Rician noise, peak signal-to-noise ratio improves by 7.6 to 11.8 dB and structural similarity roughly triples. An ablation shows that the variance-stabilized pseudo-supervision is an essential element for denoising, and that the effect is attributable to the hard thresholding contained in the stabilization transform.
blocks.zh: 声道的实时磁共振成像可以使语音表达直接被观察到,但时间分辨率和信号质量之间的取舍引入了实质性噪声并模糊了精细的动画细节. 由于移动的声道无法获得干净的参考文献,因此在此情况下不适用受监督的发音方法。 我们提出一个自我监督的去诺化框架,将spatiopal超分辨率学习与从差异稳定的非局部手段滤波器所衍生出的伪高超视觉相结合. 双模型聚变战略平衡了噪音抑制和高频动脉结构的保存. 在自然噪声条件下的USC-75多语种数据集上进行的实验表明,综艺在未见主体上将信号与噪声之比提高了11.9分贝,同时在框中实现了更高频的动脉内涵. 在调谐地实施异同位素扩散、块相配过滤、非局部手段和先发制人的非局部手段中,每个达到类似噪声抑制的配置都以高频含量或结构忠诚为代价。 在严重的加高斯语,雷利语和里克语噪声下,峰值信号-噪声比提高了7.6到11.8分贝,结构相似性大致为三相. 减值表明,差异稳定伪超视是去诺效应的基本要素,其影响可归因于稳定变形中包含的硬门槛.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) data are inherently susceptible to noise, particularly in real-time, fast, or experimental sequences, which degrades image quality [ 1 ] . Whereas denoising methods have been widely developed for brain, fetal and cardiac imaging, analogous efforts for the vocal tract remain relatively underexplored [ 2 , 3 ] . Such limitation is particularly relevant for real-time MRI (rtMRI) of the vocal tract, where the trade-off between temporal resolution and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) produces noisy magnitude frames that obscure fine articulatory structures, such as the tongue and velum, which are essential for accurate speech analysis.
blocks.zh: 磁共振成像(MRI)数据在本质上容易发生噪声,特别是在实时,快速,或实验序列中,它会降解图像质量[1]. 虽然为大脑、胎儿和心脏成像广泛开发了除鼻方法,但声道方面的类似努力仍然相对未得到充分探讨[2、3]。 这种限制对于声道的实时核磁共振(rtMRI)特别相关,在声道中,时间分辨率和信号对噪比(SNR)之间的权衡产生吵闹的量子框架,模糊了细细的动脉结构,如舌头和高音,对准确的语音分析至关重要.

blocks.en:
With the rise of deep learning, MRI denoising has shifted towards
learning-based schemes. As reported in the reviews by Chen et al. [ 2 ] and more recently by Nazir et al. [ 4 ] , convolutional encoder-decoder architectures such as the U-Net have become the standard and account for the majority of the published work along with transformer-based models, offering superior capability in capturing global dependencies and preserving fine structural details amidst complex noise patterns, such as Rician noise. Nevertheless, a recurring limitation identified in the current literature is the heavy reliance on supervised training with large paired datasets. While effective for static anatomy [ 5 ] , this dependence on clean targets presents a fundamental bottleneck for dynamic speech imaging, where physiological motion renders the acquisition of noise-free reference data physically and practically unfeasible.
blocks.zh:
随着深层次学习的兴起,核磁共振的代名词转向
以学习为基础的计划。 如Chen等人的审查所报告。 [2],以及最近由Nazir et al. [4],像U-Net这样的革命编码器-解码器架构已经成为了标准,并且与变压器模型一起占出版作品的大部分,提供了在复杂的噪声模式中捕捉全球依赖性和维护细微结构细节的优越能力,如里琴噪声. 然而,目前文献中发现的一个经常性限制是严重依赖带有大型对接数据集的有监督的培训。 虽然对静态解剖学[5]有效,但这种对清洁目标的依赖为动态语音成像提供了一个根本的瓶颈,其中生理运动使得获取无噪声的参考数据在物理上和实际上都不可行.

blocks.en: Recent research instead exploits the internal correlations of high-dimensional acquisitions to build supervisory signals without ground truth. N2SR-M by Tian et al. [ 6 ] trains on spatially sub-sampled pairs from noisy data to restore fine structures via Super-Resolution (SR) constraints. Although it was formulated for multi-contrast MRI, the principle transfers to the temporal dimension of rtMRI, and it has been validated in quantitative MRI sequences [ 7 ] and in high-speed fluorescence imaging [ 8 ] . Complementarily, we believe that conventional analytical approaches remain indispensable for their explicit handling of noise statistics and spatial signal characteristics [ 9 , 10 ] . Works such as that of Yang et al. [ 11 ] have addressed Rician noise reduction via a Pre-Smoothed Non-Local-Means (PSNLM) filter with variance stabilization, demonstrating that explicitly modeling noise characteristics is crucial for preserving anatomical detail in low-SNR regimes.
blocks.zh: 近期的研究反而利用高维获取的内部关联性来建立没有地面真实性的监督信号. N2SR-M 作者 Tian 等. [6] 列车在空间分样对上从吵闹的数据中通过超分辨率(SR)限制恢复精细结构. 虽然它是为多连续核磁共振而拟订的,但原理转移至rtMRI的时间维度,并在定量核磁共振序列[7]和高速荧光成像[8]中得到了验证. 作为补充,我们认为,传统的分析方法对于明确处理噪音统计和空间信号特征仍然是必不可少的。 作品有杨等. [11] 已经通过具有差异稳定性的预喷雾非当地-分子(PSNLM)滤波器解决了Rician噪声的减少问题,表明明确建模噪声特性对于在低SNR制度中保持解剖细节至关重要。

blocks.en: Motivated by these complementary strengths, we propose a novel self-supervised ensemble for vocal tract rtMRI denoising that combines the spatiotemporal SR strategy of N2SR-M with the noise stabilization of PSNLM. Unlike single-frame blind-spot networks [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] that rely solely on spatial context, our method exploits the spatiotemporal redundancy of speech sequences to disentangle stochastic noise from deterministic articulatory motion, achieving robust denoising without the need for a clean ground truth.
blocks.zh: 基于这些互补的优势,我们提议为声道rtMRI去诺化建立一个新的自我监督的综艺节目,将N2SR-M的spatiopal SR策略与PSNLM的噪声稳定结合起来. 与仅依靠空间背景的单帧盲点网络[12,13,14]不同,我们的方法利用语音序列的瞬间冗余,从决定性的动脉运动中分解有斑点的噪声,实现强烈的去诺,而不需要清净的地面真理.

The noisy rtMRI video is cut into overlapping clips; the spatial sub-sampling block retains one pixel from every 2 × 2 2\times 2 cell, which forms the network input, and marks the remaining three quarters in the mask M M . The network, detailed in Sec. III-C , is optimized against a PSNLM-filtered version y p y^{p} of the same clip with a composite loss that preserves edges and limits over-blurring. Only the fidelity term is restricted to M M . Eq. ( 5 ) defines all three terms of the loss function.

blocks.en: II Dataset
blocks.zh: 二. 数据集

blocks.en: We use the USC-75 dataset [ 15 ] , a multi-speaker public collection of raw and reconstructed 2-D sagittal rtMRI videos capturing speech production at the vocal tract in 75 healthy speakers. The reconstructed magnitude videos have a spatial resolution of 84 × 84 84\times 84 pixels and a temporal resolution of 83 frames/s. Consecutive frames are strongly correlated [ 16 , 17 ] , so we decimate the temporal axis by a factor of 4, which reduces the computational cost while preserving articulatory events at the time scale of interest. Rician noise and reconstruction artifacts are present in every available magnitude frame, and no noise-free counterpart exists.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 USC-75 数据集 [15], 多语种公共集 原始和重塑的 2-D sagital rtMRI 视频拍摄 在声道 制作的75 个健康演讲者。 重建后的量子视频的空间分辨率为84×8484\times 84像素,时间分辨率为83帧/s. 连续帧紧密相关[16,17],因此我们把时间轴减少4倍,从而降低计算成本,同时将动脉事件保留在时间利益尺度上. 每个可用的量级框中都有瑞嘉噪声和重建文物,不存在无噪声对应物.

blocks.en: The proposed networks were trained on a pool of 54 subjects, and all results reported below are measured on subjects outside that pool. Four clips from four unseen subjects reading the Grandfather passage are reserved for selecting the hyper-parameters of the analytical filters, so that no baseline is tuned on the data used for its evaluation. The remaining 17 unseen subjects, all reading the North Wind passage, form the test set.
blocks.zh: 拟议的网络已就54个课题进行了培训,下文报告的所有成果都根据该课题库以外的课题加以衡量。 阅读祖父段落的四个未见题材的四段片段被保留用于选择分析过滤器的超参数,因此没有调整用于评估的数据基线。 其余17个未见主体,全部阅读北风通道,组成测试集.

blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: We formulate rtMRI denoising as a self-supervised problem where no clean ground truth exists. Let X ∈ I ​ R T × H × W X\in\mathrm{I\!R}^{T\times H\times W} denote a magnitude video corrupted by signal-dependent noise, segmented into the overlapping clips x s ​ e ​ g x^{seg} of Fig. 1 before being fed to the network.
III-A Spatiotemporal Self-Supervision
blocks.zh: 三-A Spatiotal 自超视

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 , we adopt a similar sub-sampling strategy as N2SR-M [ 6 ] to enable training without noise-free targets. The operator 𝒟 s : I ​ R T × H × W → I ​ R T × H 2 × W 2 \mathcal{D}_{s}:\mathrm{I\!R}^{T\times H\times W}\rightarrow\mathrm{I\!R}^{T\times\frac{H}{2}\times\frac{W}{2}} partitions every frame into non-overlapping 2 × 2 2\times 2 cells and keeps one pixel per cell, drawn uniformly at random and independently for each cell and each frame. The retained pixels form the network input, while the remaining three quarters, collected in the mask M M , are the only pixels on which the fidelity term of the loss is evaluated. Since the withheld pixel is not part of the input, its noise realization cannot be predicted from the observations, and the network is constrained to interpolate the underlying anatomy rather than to reproduce the noise of the target. blocks.en: III-C Network Architecture
blocks.zh: 三-C 网络结构

blocks.en: We design a spatiotemporal U-Net with a pre-activation scheme [ 19 ] , consisting of four main components: 1. Spatiotemporal Feature Extraction: the backbone consists of 3-D residual blocks enhanced with squeeze-and-excitation (SE) modules [ 20 ] to model channel-wise dependencies. 2. Anti-Aliasing Downsampling: strided convolutions are replaced with non-learnable Gaussian blur filters to mitigate aliasing artifacts. 3. SR Upsampling: as in N2SR-M, reconstruction is performed by a SR block of 3-D transposed convolutions followed by projection-based refinement layers. 4. Temporal-Only Attention: a bottleneck attention block that focuses strictly on temporal dependencies to enforce frame-to-frame consistency.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一个具有预激活计划[19]的瞬间U-Net,由四个主要组成部分组成: 1. Spatiotemporal Feature Departmenton:主干由三维残块组成,加装了挤压和激发(SE)模块[20],以模型化通道依赖性. 2. 反阿利辛·唐式采样:用不易学习的高斯模糊滤波器来取代悬浮式采样,以减轻对文物的异名. 3. SR Upsampling:与N2SR-M一样,重建由三维移位的SR块进行,然后是以投影为基础的改进层。 4. 仅限时间 注意:一个瓶颈的注意块,严格注重时间依赖性,以强制实现帧对帧的一致性.

blocks.en: The encoder has four stages with channel multipliers ( 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 ) (1,2,4,8) and two residual blocks per stage, and the SR block outputs twice the input grid in each spatial dimension.

We observed that a single value of λ 1 \lambda_{1} imposes a compromise between texture preservation and noise suppression, so we train two networks with different values and fuse their outputs. f HF f_{\mathrm{HF}} uses 16 base channels, 3-frame clips and λ 1 = 1.2 \lambda_{1}=1.2 , which favors high-frequency detail and edges; f LF f_{\mathrm{LF}} uses 48 base channels, 40-frame clips and λ 1 = 0.7 \lambda_{1}=0.7 , which favors global smoothness and the preservation of the original anatomical structure. blocks.en: III-E Training and Inference
blocks.zh: 三-E 培训和推论

blocks.en: Both networks are trained with AdamW, a learning rate of 2 ⋅ 10 − 4 2\cdot 10^{-4} for f HF f_{\mathrm{HF}} and 5 ⋅ 10 − 4 5\cdot 10^{-4} for f LF f_{\mathrm{LF}} , and a plateau schedule on the validation loss. At inference the sub-sampling is removed and the full-resolution video is passed through both networks; overlapping clips are merged by averaging and the super-resolved output is resampled back to the acquisition grid before the fusion of Eq. ( 6 ). No filter is applied at inference; all values reported for the proposed models are raw network outputs.
blocks.zh: 两个网络都经过了AdamW的训练,FHF f_{\mathrm{HF}}和FLF f_{\mathrm{LF}}的学习率为2 → 10 → 4 2\cdot 10 → 4 → 4 → 10\cdot 10 → 4 → 4 → FLF f_{\mathrm{LF}} → ,以及验证损失的高原时间表. 推断子采样被移除,全分辨率视频通过两个网络传递;重叠的片段通过平均合并,超解的输出在Eq.(6 )聚变前被重新复制回收购网格. 推论不采用过滤器;为拟议模型报告的所有数值均为原始网络产出。

ADF quantizes the soft tissue into piecewise-constant regions, BM4D-3D removes the noise together with the textures, and PSNLM T \mathrm{PSNLM}_{\mathrm{T}} preserves the anatomy but flattens the background, while PSNLM V \mathrm{PSNLM}_{\mathrm{V}} changes the signal much less. blocks.en: IV Results
blocks.zh: 四. 结果

blocks.en: We assess performance in two scenarios: the original USC-75 rtMRI data, which contain only the noise present at acquisition, and a controlled setting in which synthetic noise is added to the same videos. In both, the ensemble is benchmarked against representative analytical denoisers, after which the pseudo-supervision that drives the training objective is ablated.
blocks.zh: 我们在两种情景中评估性能:最初的USC-75 rtMRI数据只包含获取时的噪声,以及在同一视频中添加合成噪声的控制设置. 在两者中,综艺节目都以具有代表性的分析代言人为基准,之后推动训练目标的伪监督被淡化.

blocks.en: IV-B Reference-Free Evaluation

blocks.en: Table I reports quality averaged over the 17 test subjects, and Fig. 3 the paired difference between each method and the input of that same subject. Fig. 2 illustrates one of these clips, with its own measurements printed underneath.

blocks.en: The two members and their fusion behave as designed. f LF f_{\mathrm{LF}} yields the highest rSNR of the three by prioritizing global smoothness, at the cost of TV and of an SSIM of 0.56 with respect to the input, which reflects structural deviation caused by over-smoothing. f HF f_{\mathrm{HF}} recovers sharper textures, with the largest TV gain among all methods considered, at an SSIM of 0.87. The ensemble balances the two effects, suppressing noise by 11.9 dB while increasing TV by 2.73 at an SSIM of 0.85, with visible improvements in fine articulatory structures such as the velum (Fig. 2 ). Across the test subjects, the rSNR gain decreases and the TV gain increases monotonically with w w , from + + 18.2 dB and + + 0.32 at w = 0.1 w=0.1 to + + 11.2 dB and + + 3.08 at w = 0.9 w=0.9 .

blocks.en: With respect to the analytical denoisers ADF, NLM and BM4D, the latter two also in their 3-D forms, improve rSNR by between 5.2 and 11.4 dB, and reduce TV by 0.34 to 3.20 (Fig. 3 ). PSNLM T \mathrm{PSNLM}_{\mathrm{T}} achieves the largest rSNR gain among the analytical filters, 14.3 dB at the setting used to generate the pseudo-targets and 20.1 dB in its 3-D form. At that setting it is also the only analytical operating point in Fig. 3 that increases TV, by 0.65. Both results are obtained at an SSIM of 0.57, that is, with substantial deviation from the input. The Rician stabilized PSNLM V \mathrm{PSNLM}_{\mathrm{V}} shows the opposite behavior: it maintains an SSIM of 0.80 but suppresses only 6.4 dB and still reduces TV. No analytical filter achieves the three properties simultaneously; only the ensemble and its f HF f_{\mathrm{HF}} member suppress noise, increase high-frequency content and remain close to the input. The additional gradient energy introduced by the ensemble remains correlated with the anatomy of the input with a 0.96 Pearson correlation, which indicates that it corresponds to recovered detail and not to added noise. The hyper-parameter search for the filters leads to the same conclusion: of the 5950 configurations scored on the tuning clips, 1870 match the structural fidelity of the ensemble, and none of these exceeds it in both rSNR and TV. The highest TV among them is 9.88, against 12.53 for the ensemble on the same clips, and no configuration in the entire search exceeds 10.27, for an input value of 9.59.

blocks.en: IV-C Reference-Based Evaluation
blocks.zh: 参考评价

blocks.en: We additionally evaluate the ensemble on USC-75 frames corrupted with Gaussian, Rayleigh, and Rician noise at σ = 0.2 \sigma=0.2 , using three reference-based metrics against the uncorrupted frame: the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), the normalized root mean squared error (NRMSE) and SSIM, which here compares the output with that reference rather than with the noisy input. As shown in Fig. 4 , the method suppresses severe contamination under all three distributions, with w = 0.1 w=0.1 to maintain the high SNR of f LF f_{\mathrm{LF}} while injecting sufficient high-frequency content to sharpen articulatory edges. PSNR increases from 15.5 to 23.6 dB under Gaussian noise, from 11.4 to 23.2 dB under Rayleigh noise and from 13.3 to 20.9 dB under Rician noise, and SSIM increases from 0.19, 0.24 and 0.16 to 0.58, 0.63 and 0.52 respectively, an approximately threefold improvement. This indicates that the geometry of the articulators is largely preserved under severe degradation.

blocks.en: The results are shown in Fig. 5 . For F T F_{\mathrm{T}} as pseudo-target the fused output reaches an rSNR of 37.1 dB, being reduced to 29.8 dB for F V F_{\mathrm{V}} , whereas training on the raw noisy clip gives 22.5 dB, indistinguishable from the 22.4 dB of its own input, at an SSIM of 0.98 with respect to that input. Without a filtered target the network does not denoise but reproduces its input. The sub-sampling of Sec. III-A is therefore not sufficient on its own, since it decouples only the Charbonnier term of Eq. ( 5 ) from the input noise. ℒ G \mathcal{L}_{G} is evaluated on all pixels, so with a noisy target it drives the output to reproduce the gradient field of the noise, and neither term addresses the non-zero-mean Rician floor of Eq. ( 2 ). The validation metrics of the original full-scale trainings, which paired the same configuration with and without the pseudo-target, are consistent with this: relative to its own input, the pseudo-target arm gains 11.8 dB and the noisy-target arm loses 0.7 dB, at essentially unchanged TV (7.87 and 7.70 respectively). The pseudo-target arm also exceeds the pseudo-target on which it was trained by 4.1 dB, showing that it does not simply reproduce the filter.

blocks.en: Table II shows which of the two operations composing F T F_{\mathrm{T}} , the hard threshold or the Anscombe root, accounts for its advantage over F V F_{\mathrm{V}} . This is a separate, smaller experiment than the one above: only the f HF f_{\mathrm{HF}} member is retrained, against a pseudo-target built from each half of Eq. ( 4 ) in isolation, with the non-local means stage, the noise estimator, the data, the schedule and the seed held fixed as before. The threshold alone reaches 33.0 dB, most of the 35.6 dB obtained with the full transform, whereas the Anscombe root alone reaches 22.7 dB, the same level as the arm trained without a pseudo-target at all. The supervision therefore derives from the hard thresholding rather than from the variance stabilization alone for which the transform was initially introduced.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: We presented a self-supervised ensemble for blind vocal tract rtMRI denoising that requires no clean ground truth. By combining spatiotemporal SR training with a stabilized pseudo-supervision and a dual-model fusion strategy, the method effectively separates signal-dependent noise from dynamic articulatory structures across the USC-75 dataset. The ensemble mitigates the smoothness-sharpness trade-off inherent in single-model approaches. On the original data, a balanced fusion enhances high-frequency articulatory detail without distorting global anatomy, while under severe synthetic degradation, a stronger low-frequency contribution drives robust structural recovery. In both cases, the ensemble yields quantitatively and qualitatively superior results among the compared filters, demonstrating the viability of purely self-supervised methods for vocal tract rtMRI applications where clean reference data is physically unattainable.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个自我监督的综艺节目 用于盲调声道 rtMRI去鼻音,不需要干净的真相。 通过将spatiotemporal SR训练与稳定的伪超视觉和双模型聚变策略相结合,该方法有效地将信号依赖噪声与整个USC-75数据集的动态动脉结构区分开来. 综艺减轻了单模式方法所固有的平滑-尖端权衡. 在原始数据上,均衡聚变可以增强高频动脉学细节而不会扭曲全球解剖学,而在严重的合成退化下,更强的低频贡献可以推动强劲的结构恢复. 在这两种情况下,综艺节目在比较滤波器中产生质和量的优异结果,表明纯自我监督的声道rtMRI应用方法在物理上无法实现清洁参考数据的情况下是可行的。

blocks.en: A comparison against different classical filters, searched exhaustively over their hyper-parameters, shows that suppressing the noise floor while increasing high-frequency articulatory content at comparable structural fidelity is not reachable by re-tuning the filters. The ablation shows that the pseudo-supervision, rather than the super-resolution constraint alone, drives the denoising, and that its effect comes from the hard threshold in F T F_{\mathrm{T}} rather than from the variance-stabilizing root.
blocks.zh: 与不同的古典滤波器进行对比,在它们的超参数上详尽地搜索,结果显示,在相似的结构忠诚度上,在增加高频动脉内含物的同时压制噪音地板是无法通过重新调整滤波器达到的。 衰减表明,伪超视觉,而不是仅超解约束,驱动解析,其效果来自F T T → mathrm{T}} → 硬阈值,而非差异稳定根.
